content: Kyakin, bi iwɛy an'lɔɔŋ a nsɛmà mà Klistɔ, bi ileŋ ma akwà man'kwo ntɔn andweer, ukɔɔn afurà unsà indiir a un'bään asànaa: mubuul mpem, muwɛy isal byàfàtwaal ukwà anà mukal anà làkwikilà amu Nzam,
an'lɔɔŋ a ndüümà anà màsyeel an'kɔɔ, ngwiiyà a akü anà ntsüül a nsaŋ ipepey.
Ler ndaa iyàkyer bi, isàkal naa Nzam an'pà mbwo.
Ya ikwe anki naa baar abà bàwɛl pɛɛlà, bàwem ntsà a kab a du, bàtüüb a Dweelà In'kyɛɛl,
bàlɛɛr ndaa a Nzam yàŋàbwaŋ anà ngwal a mɛɛn amà isàyà,
anà bàkyàbwà, ba bàkwe anki mufàbuul mpem, ntɔn mufàfuur Mwan a Nzam u kulunsi ntɔn mbuul a mpem aba anà mukun'mɛɛy nswɛn u mii a baar.
Umpal ifànwà mɛɛn an'dà a mbul màfànɔ udu a ma mbalà mbɔɔn anà màfàtwey in'te a mfun ntɔn baar bàfàkɔn ma, ma ifàwal nsaak akà Nzam.
Wɛɛ, isàkal naa ma màfàtwey nà ibwiy a nsyɛɛnà anà mikyɛɛl, ndöŋ ama yatɛy, itaan tɛy bàkyer ayàküül ma anà bàyàsà ma mbaa.
Wɛɛ akà bɛ, nkween amɛ, itàkal naa bi kan'tɛn abwɛy, bi kan'sà kam naa bɛ làbà u ntsü aŋàbwaŋ, ntsü a ngweel a mɔ̈ɔ̈.
Ntɔn, Nzam wà balàbal. Nde ufàdiimà anki isal abɛ anà ukwen làswɛŋ bɛ ntɔn ikɔb ande umpal làsyääl bɛ aŋin'kyɛɛl anà làfàlab bɛ mukasyääl.
Wɛɛ, ngyal abi yà naa mbuur mbuur uboo a bɛ uswɛŋ mbämà nsil ya tii u ntsüü, ntɔn làkyän abɛ làkwe ubwaŋàbwaŋ.
Abun, twon lan'kwaam ngwal abɛ, wɛɛ làyweel baar abà u mbwo a làkwikilà unsà mukwüünà, anà bàwal kwal a ilää kàpɛ Nzam.
Kiin ilää a Nzam
Umpal kàpɛ Nzam Abàlam ilää, nde kàdi kyän u mbwo a nde ŋàkwo, ntɔn mbuur aŋàsöön nde kàkäl anki.
Nde kàtɛn naa: « Ndandaa, mɛ in'sayööl a nsaak anà in'sapà in'lwaaŋ a baar mbɔɔn! »
Kyakin, Abàlam kàdil unsà muküünà, waa kàwɛl undiir kun'pɛ Nzam ilää.
Kyekà, baar bàfàdyà kyän bàfàkyer kà ikɔb a mbuur aŋàsöön ba ŋakwo, anà mumay mbaaŋ yanswà, ba bàfàdüül musà mbɔ̈ɔ̈l a kyän.
Abun, Nzam kàkwen muswaŋ ubwaŋàbwaŋ akà aŋakwal a ilää naa an'kyän ande ifàsɔɔmà anki, kyakin kàmɛɛy nde kya u mbwo a kyän.

Abun, bye anà indiir byeel mpa byàfàsɔɔmà, u mbwo a bya, ikwe anki akà ikikye naa Nzam utɛ loor. Bya byàmitwääl ndɛɛl yàngwal, akà bi baar kàwɛy indiir byanswà ntɔn mukaar làkyän alà biböön.
Akà bi, làkyän là asànaa löŋ a mɔ̈ɔ̈ abi, làngwal anà làŋàbäm ubwaŋ, la làfàbilà ungö a rido,
ikal kàbilà Yɛsu kusà a bi ntɔn bi. Nde kàbulà undweer a angaŋ wà mbul a in'tye kà un'lwaaŋ a Mɛlkisɛdɛk.
